summary: Set defaultChecked with boolean-attribute and dirty-checkedness synchronization semantics.

target.notes: Reflect to the checked content attribute; if dirty checkedness is false, current checkedness tracks the attribute.

caveats: Changing defaultChecked must not overwrite user/script checkedness after dirty checkedness becomes true.

tests.name: dirty checkedness is preserved
tests.input: const i=document.createElement('input'); i.type='checkbox'; i.checked=true; i.defaultChecked=false; console.log(i.checked,i.defaultChecked);
